'''Matthew Reed''' (also published as '''Matt Reed''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 81 from Huntsville, Al. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref> At DecipherCon 1999 he finished 2nd in the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship (Open Champs) and 14th in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Matthew Reed also played at [[March 2001 Huntsville tournament]] on 10 March 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ORS ISB]], according to Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 12 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026020443/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ Internet Archive].</ref>
